models.title: ALBA - Professional Espresso Grinder
models.description_en: Crafted in Milan, Italy, Alba assures remarkable speed and precision through its cutting-edge 80 mm flat burrs. It features an innovative 3.5-inch touchscreen display that seamlessly guides users through three programmable recipes, and lets baristas monitor statistical usage metrics related to the grinder. Speed and performance for high volume espresso grinding at an unbeatable value, with a double shot in 2.6 seconds, an adjustable and easily removable spout for centered dosing, single-handed stepless grind-size adjustment, and simple service access without full disassembly.

specs.dosing_type: On-demand/doserless, màn cảm ứng 3.5" với 3 công thức lập trình sẵn + theo dõi thống kê sử dụng

models.seo_description: Speed and performance for high volume espresso grinding at an unbeatable value.

models.title: LUNA - Professional Espresso Grinder
models.description_en: Modernized design and clever user-centric features, with a tough to beat value proposition — the Luna is grinding redefined. It delivers impressive speed and quality through its newly developed 65 mm flat hardened steel burrs, providing an intuitive grinding experience for baristas. An innovative 3.5-inch touchscreen display guides users through 3 programmable recipes that can be locked for different user groups via owner control password and "manual mode", while enabling baristas to track statistical usage metrics. Modern design made in Italy with long-lasting metal construction and environmentally friendly packaging.

specs.burr_type: Flat, special steel premium (made in Germany)
specs.dosing_type: Doserless (on-demand), màn cảm ứng 3.5" 3 công thức lập trình + số liệu sử dụng, giao diện mở cho nội dung bên thứ ba

models.seo_description: Best value for performance in professional espresso grinding.

models.title: PRATICA - Professional Espresso Grinder
models.description_en: Designed for medium-volume cafes, the Pratica is Anfim's latest and fastest on-demand grinder, capable of processing up to 6 kg of coffee daily at 1,700 RPM. It includes an intuitive display offering six programmable recipes and automated hands-free operation, with stepless adjustment and a locking mechanism to prevent unwanted grind changes, re-designed hardened steel 65mm grinding discs for maximum flavour extraction, and 1/10th of a second adjustable single, double, and manual grinding modes. Combines traditional Italian design with fresh on-demand grinding, suiting medium to high-volume cafes that require rapid grinding and absolute control.

specs.dosing_type: On-demand/doserless, màn hình 6 công thức lập trình, tự động start/stop, điều chỉnh 1/10 giây

models.seo_description: Traditional Italian design meets on-demand grinding.

models.title: SOLIDA - Professional Espresso Grinder
models.description_en: Anfim's Solida combines traditional Italian design with the most accurate dosers in the world, ensuring fast and easy espresso portioning. The grinder delivers value through redesigned grinding disc geometry, durable construction, and user-friendly features including stepless grind adjustment, aiming for accurate, consistent dose-to-dose doser grinding for espresso applications.

specs.dosing_type: Doser (6-9 g/s điều chỉnh được)

models.seo_description: Anfim's SOLIDA combines traditional Italian design with the most accurate dosers in the world, ensuring fast and easy espresso portioning.
